If you can start regularly getting 9+ hours of sleep, you will begin to wake up more naturally between REM cycles. Keep a dream journal : diligently maintained over seasons, it will show you the feeling or location or people or shapes that recur when you dream, which is a powerful aid forward. Don't go from the computer to bed : dedicate yourself to whole-body activity or restfulness for awhile beforehand. When you can go to bed easily, without tension or intrusive thoughts, equipped with a map of your own hypnogogic borderlands, you will eventually find success. Entire cultures were swayed by the idea that what you are seeking was the gateway to the domain of the gods and the dead. Don't be discouraged or lazy. Our office used to have a monthly birthday lunch, but it was canceled when too many people complained about it breaking their diets. Now my boss's birthday is coming up, and our department of four is divided. One girl is adamant about baking cupcakes. Her cupcakes are amazing, but our boss has diabetes, so that just seems kinda cruel! Another wants us all to chip in for a fancy gift that he already has all picked out, and the third says we should just take him out for a nice lunch and cover his cost, but I'm on a very tight budget. When I suggested simply buying a nice card and all signing it, they looked at me like I had two heads. Am I in the wrong? This is my first job and I haven't worked here very long (just six months.) I don't want to be uncooperative or have a bad relationship with my coworkers or my boss.
How should we recognize our boss's birthday?

You are not wrong.

Buying a spendy gift for your boss is inappropriate. He will should feel uncomfortable receiving extravagant items from his subordinates, and you admit that you cannot afford to contribute to this or a group outing. If you give in, it'll cost you in more ways than one. Whether your boss loves it or hates it, resentment is inevitable.

That being said, people love to eat. Perhaps you could collaborate with your baking coworker to find a diabetic-friendly cupcake recipe -- there are plenty of good ones out there. On the day, simply invite other employees to stop by, grab a cupcake and sign a card for your boss. Those who are concerned about their diets will appreciate a healthier treat (or can continue to abstain), and you won't be putting your boss on the spot.
